# P35.51 — Page budgets, generated LHCI config, real-sized synthetic national fixture

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/329_P35.51__page-budgets-lhci-national-fixture.md`
(manifest row **329**, Round 11 / P35). Invoked `live_verification=false` —
committed code, specs, fixture builder and CI wiring only. **This row
performs no hosted mutation, no live legs and no publication:** the budgets
bind in CI on merge; no public page's content or script payload changes.
Requirement stamps: **SIG-UI-041** (budgets per page type, enforced in CI),
**SIG-UI-036/050** (as ADR-155 amended them — the registry this row's
budgets hang off). Cited: **ADR-155** + **D-K0-1 [A-12] = a** (the §4.3/§4.9
budget table is already ratified — copied verbatim, never re-decided; no
budget raised, no T2 surface added), **ADR-134** (the island-budgets
machinery this row retires), **ADR-097** (the T2 surfaces measured),
**ADR-068** (`/curate/**` stays T3 — accessibility-only by decision, not by
omission), K0-interactive-architecture §4.3 (the numbers) + §4.12 items
4–6 (this row's). **Base:** `r11/P35.50-page-type-registry-and-route-discovery`
(PR #348, head `23d37bb`, 5/5 green at dispatch). **Gate:** none.

## The problem

The performance budgets were island-scoped (`island-budgets.json` named
three surfaces), the `lighthouserc` files were hand-maintained, and every
measurement ran against the committed fixture corpus — a corpus small
enough that nothing at real scale could ever go over budget. ADR-155's
budgets are per *page type*; a hand list can miss a route; and a budget
never exercised at national scale is a number, not a gate. This row makes
the contract registry-driven, generates the LHCI config, and proves the
budgets against a deterministic synthetic fixture at real national size —
with the gaps it finds recorded as measured gaps, never hidden.

## What landed

- **`web/tests/e2e/page-budgets.json`** (new, the single contract) —
  `sig.page-budgets/1`: every K0 §4.3 row verbatim (T0 zero-JS/≤150 KiB;
  T1 20/40 KiB script, ≤170 KiB initial; T2-map 360/60 KiB script,
  ≤450 KiB initial, ≤1.5 MiB first-view, ≤500 KiB pan/zoom; T2-graph
  120/60 KiB, ≤250 KiB; T2-search 60/40 KiB, ≤180 KiB, ≤50 KiB
  per-keystroke/≤40 KiB per-page; T3 accessibility-only per ADR-068) —
  document, script-initial/after-action, total transfer, data budgets,
  LCP/CLS/TBT/interaction-latency, Lighthouse performance floors, a11y 1.0.
  `measured_gaps` keep the ratified ceiling as the reported law, attach a
  scoped regression bound (measured must not grow), and name the owning
  deferral — never a smoothed ceiling.
- **`page-budget-check.ts` + rewritten `budget.spec.ts`** — every
  discovered route resolves to exactly one budget row; every row is
  exercised by ≥ 1 route. Raw **and gzip and brotli** measured on initial
  load and after each surface's declared interaction (map pan, network
  focus, search keystroke); an interaction that produces no observable
  effect fails the run — "measured without interacting" is caught.
- **`gen-lhci.mjs`** (new) — renders `lighthouserc.json`,
  `lighthouserc.export.json`, `lighthouserc.national.json` from
  `dist/page-types.json` + the contract; `--verify` is the committed-file
  drift gate wired into `check` after `build`. Measured gaps render as
  warn-at-ratified-ceiling / error-at-regression-bound.
- **`scripts/ci/build_national_fixture.py`** (new) — deterministic
  synthetic national corpus, seed `20261022`: **232,500 sites, 5,200
  agencies, 405,000 sharing edges**, 48 access paths, 209,292 locatable
  sites, H3 r3, real PMTiles via `exports.tiles`. Every name invented
  (`Synthetic`/`Syn` markers); a recursive `assert_no_real_names` guard
  scans every emitted string against a vendor/jurisdiction blocklist and
  fails the build on a doctored row. Output under `web/national/` is
  gitignored — generated per run, seed committed.
- **`data.ts`** — `SIG_DATA_SOURCE=national` declared overlay: the
  national dir (`SIG_NATIONAL_DIR`) supplies the heavy artifacts it names;
  every uncovered getter still serves committed fixtures. Missing dir or
  malformed artifact fails loud — never a silent fallback.
- **`exports/tiles.py`** — leaf-directory PMTiles support. Found only at
  scale: the national root directory exceeds the client's optimistic
  16 KiB first range, so tile fetches failed; root entries now carry
  `run_length == 0` leaf pointers within the 3.1 PMTiles spec.
- **`network.astro`/`map.astro`** — bounded prop/focus-adjacency windows
  at real size with honest totals preserved on the static surface; map
  first-view bytes measured as their own budget row.
- **Retired island machinery** — `island-budgets.json`,
  `measure-island-budgets.mjs`, the island perf spec, hand-authored
  lighthouserc files, and every stale consumer (allow-list, AGENTS
  gotchas, workflow comments, `test_ci_workflows.py` invariants).
- **CI** — `check:perf` rewired: build the national fixture →
  `SIG_DATA_SOURCE=national` build → `measure-page-budgets.mjs` →
  `lhci autorun` over `lighthouserc.national.json` → `budget.spec.ts`.
  `export_mode_leg.sh` rewired to page budgets; `national_budget_leg.sh`
  added.
- **`D-P35.51-1/2/3`** recorded in DEFERRALS + event-chain anchors —
  the measured gaps this row is forbidden to hide.

| `/network/` national | document / total / latency | 102,400 B / 256,000 B / 200 ms | ≈1.77 MB / ≈1.85 MB / ≈284 ms | 1,800,000 / 1,900,000 / 400 ms |

- `budget.spec.ts` — **46/46 national build, 46/46 fixtures build.**
- `test_national_fixture.py` — 8/8; two at-scale builds **byte-identical**

- `gen-lhci.mjs --verify` green over all three configs; drift fails.
- `check:paths` containment holds at 157 (the `nationalDir()` slash-guard
  exempted via the designed file+token+count+reason allow-list).
- `make check` — see run ledger.

## Out of scope (per ticket)

Fixing the measured gaps (the owning deferrals); `/network/`'s T1
migration and `/explore/` (GX-09a); UXK0-4's enhancement entries; any
ADR-155 amendment (a raised budget or new T2 surface is a new ADR, not a
line edit); CSP headers (P36.19).
